description: No capabilities file existed in this project before this: Tauri v2's ACL denies every plugin command by default without one. Confirmed live against a real running build -- `plugin:shell|open` failed with "not allowed by ACL", meaning the update banner's Download link could never open anything, on desktop or Android. Custom app-defined #[tauri::command]s (printing, LAN discovery, etc.) are unaffected -- the ACL only gates plugin-namespaced commands. Applies to both platforms since the shell plugin is registered unconditionally.
